entities.summary: Air France Flight 7775 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Pau Pyrénées Airport to Charles de Gaulle Airport in France which crashed shortly after takeoff during wintry conditions. The flight was operated by Air France's regional subsidiary Régional using a Fokker 100. All passengers survived the incident but one person on the ground was killed. An investigation by the BEA determined that the cause of the accident was ice on the wings of the aircraft along with excessive rotation in the weather conditions during takeoff.
